_comment: cg27a_rcode3: cg27a_rcode2 + ONE model change (inf_rcode_sel code+aa, inf_rti_max 100): write the 100 held-out pairs the compressed code AND chaining (Adamic-Adar) agree on most (rank sum) instead of the 200 with the most similar codes. cg27a_rcode2 showed the weights take in whatever is taught (taught right 0.40 / wrong 0.38, held back 0.00-0.03), so what is written must be more often right. Offline (Re-DocRED gold, two splits): top 100 right 0.42-0.45 vs 0.38-0.41 for the code alone (top 50: 0.50-0.62); inside the model on the 10k distant slice (distant labels, 512 dims): top 100 right 0.60 vs 0.41 code alone, 0.34 Adamic-Adar alone. Readouts: [COMPRESSED FACT TABLE] adds the SELECTION RULES (each rule's top 100 / 200); the rank recall readout now uses held-back answers as distractors (a fair control). Previous: cg27a_rcode2: cg27a_rcode + ONE model change (inf_rti_rows 8): the written real-text inferences get their OWN question rows, 8 added to every question-row step (cg27a_rcode: about one row per inference per visit from the shared pool, never read in any text). Offline (tools/teach_diag.py, stand-in trunk, 120 real pairs): about 2.5 rows per fact moves rank recall 0.28 -> 0.34 and fades to 0.29; 10 rows 0.44 (kept 0.37); 40 rows 0.74 (kept 0.47); name familiarity, the gold relation phrase and reading the source sentence add little (0.39-0.53 at 10 rows). Readout inf_rti_rank_recall 1: the answer ranked among 10 written answers - open-ended exact recall (the cg27a_rcode readout) cannot see real multi-word names (offline 0.01 while rank is 0.74). Previous: cg27a_rcode: INFERENCE BY COMPRESSING THE FACT TABLE. cg27a_rti + ONE model change (inf_rti_code 1): what is written is chosen by a low-rank CODE per name (PPMI of the store's name x name record graph, truncated SVD, 128 dims; no labels) instead of chains + the trunk's check. 10% of the distant documents read are held out: their records leave the graph, and so does every record pairing two names that co-occur in one of them - nothing in the store states a candidate pair. The top inf_rti_max held-out pairs by code similarity are written as 'A is connected to C' (a third held back). Offline: Re-DocRED gold, two splits, codes right 0.32-0.37 in their top 5% where a chain exists (3.8x base; best chaining score 0.24) and 2x base where no chain exists; the 10k distant slice (distant labels): code AUC 0.611 vs Adamic-Adar 0.590, top 200 written right 0.39 vs base 0.08. Readout [COMPRESSED FACT TABLE] replicates the comparison at scale every readout. Previous: cg27a_rti: END-TO-END REAL-TEXT INFERENCE. cg27a_xgain + the PREMISES AT SCALE store (readout machinery) + ONE model change: inf_rti_write 1 - READ (a separate record store reads DocRED's distant Wikipedia set and the benchmark documents) -> CHOOSE premises label-free (a random 10% of scored records: on the GPU no label-free premise policy beat random for inference; inf_rti_policy) -> INFER A-C through a shared name from another document, kept with 2+ bridges -> CHECK by the model (the trunk ranks C in its top 3 of C and 9 names of the same class after 'A is connected to ') -> WRITE the passing ones (up to 200 per readout) into the question pool as facts 'A is connected to C', a fifth held back. Readouts: [REAL-TEXT INFERENCE] (each step's counts, right share of passed vs failed, the check's AUC) and [REAL-TEXT INFERENCE WRITES] (recall from the trunk of written inferences, taught vs held back, RIGHT vs WRONG = false memories). The surprise-gated store (cg27a_prem's change) stays OFF so the write is the only change. Previous: cg27a_prem: cg27a_xgain + THE SURPRISE-GATED STORE (inf_sstore 1; ONE model change) + the PREMISES AT SCALE readout (inf_premises 1; readout only). Offline tests of 13 November: types appear when compression runs over a large record store (purity 0.50 -> 0.72 with 28x the records), inference by recall needs premises of about 0.6-0.7 precision (0.13 at 0.38, 0.31 at 0.70), and records the trunk finds surprising hold more new true facts (27.0 vs 21.6 per 100). The model change: real-text sentences enter the fast store only if the trunk finds them surprising (bits per byte at or above the domain's running median); [SURPRISE GATE] reports what was admitted and whether gold-related benchmark pairs are kept over co-occurrences. The readout: a SEPARATE record store reads DocRED's distant Wikipedia set (101,873 documents, a tenth more each visit; downloaded by the notebook) plus the benchmark documents; every 2 visits TYPES by record-level compression warm-started from the last readout, the RELATION cue, the trunk's SURPRISE per record, PREMISE precision by policy and A-C INFERENCE by policy. Previous: cg27a_xgain: cg27a_rtxw + the EXTRACTION GAIN readout (inf_extract_gain 1; readout only,
_inf_jx: train the index each sleep and print the JEPA INDEX readouts; readouts only, the trunk is not trained
_inf_jx_dim: encoder width and depth (about 3M parameters); local runs use 128 x 3
_inf_jx_nce: 0 = pure V-JEPA (EMA target, L1, no negatives); > 0 adds InfoNCE over the batch (the toy: helps when facts share a subject)
_inf_jx_pool: the most recent live stored sentences that are keyed
_inf_jx_arm_nce: arm C: a second encoder trained with this InfoNCE weight added to the L1 (local end of run top-1 0.85 against 0.76 for arm V)
_inf_jx_gen: arm G, the generic trace: names found by the store's own name finder are masked before encoding and kept as slots; retrieval among the sentences whose slots hold the question's name, ranked by the name-free key (local HYBRID 1.00)
_inf_jx_pair: paired-wording training stays off: locally it did not raise held-out retrieval (0.12 with it against 0.15 without)
_inf_jx_route: JEPA ROUTING readout: each visit's stored sentences in 1 KB windows routed by bytes, by JEPA codes and by both, at 1 and 4 windows; routing itself unchanged
_cd_klclass: REPLAY SIGNAL BY BYTE CLASS readout: every 25th conduit call, share of the teacher KL and byte loss on space/punctuation, digits, function words, names and other words
_inf_jx_gen_nce: InfoNCE weight on arm G (the generic trace): on the GPU the L1-only arms collapsed in the first sleeps (key spread 0.17-0.24) before recovering
_inf_jx_ctxdiag: CONTEXT DIAGNOSTIC line: one-hop picks by summed and by mean byte log-probability, the planted fact sentence in context, whether the stored true sentence holds the fact, share of wrong picks that are shorter names, two examples
_inf_jx_gen_aud: weight of the audit-pair InfoNCE on arm G: question form 'So A is connected to ' -> the premise the audit verified, against other sentences naming the same name (toy, 2 seeds: held-out wording 0.08 -> 0.36, two-hop 0.43 -> 0.49)
_cd_store_text: the fast store (hippocampus) also reads the plain text of closed-loop visits; the trunk still learns only from verified replays (local, no hints: updated one-hop 0.00 -> 0.80, stale 1.00 -> 0.20; two-hop with the store 0.40 -> 0.71; final BPC 2.554 -> 2.562, within noise)
_cd_mem_hint: memory hints stay off: locally they never fired (replays failed before a verified anchor); N > 0 lets the stored sentence matching the verified bytes before a replay's first wrong byte supply up to N bytes
_inf_conc_wordings: conclusions written in several wordings (common._CONC_FWD / _CONC_REV, none a test wording) in TRUNK REPLAY only; the fast store keeps one canonical form (inf_conc_wordings_store 0, the default)
_inf_cons_contrast: competitor contrast in conclusion replay: softplus(logit(negative) - logit(answer)) at the byte where each negative name leaves the answer
_inf_cons_contrast_k: negatives per row: other live conclusions' answers in the same role, never a true answer of the given name
_inf_cons_infow: information-weighted answer bytes: w = s / mean(s), s = bits of the byte after a neutral cue (the given name replaced by someone), clipped to [0.25, 4]
_inf_cf_wordings: closed-form edits fitted on the keys of the first 3 wordings of common._CONC_CF (the first is the original)
_inf_cf_contrast: competitor contrast in the closed-form edit fit (divergence byte, as in replay)
_inf_selcmp: readout at the end of the run (north-star rung 0): trained JEPA selector against closed-form CCA/SFA (plain and weighted beyond a shuffled null), trunk cosine, TF-IDF names, random; retrieval incl. held-out wording, judge, Re-DocRED relations
_inf_rdr_judge: readout at the end of the run: relational signal in the trunk on Re-DocRED prose (substitution and mutual-compression AUC)
_inf_open_diag: per visit: teacher-forced open-ended diagnostic (open hit, answer bytes top-1, first-byte rank, bits behind, winner a letter) for the fitted, other written and held-out wordings; at pass ends and the end, RUNG 3 KEYS (held-out question -> own conclusion by nearest fitted key)
_inf_cf_shadow: on: shadow edits - NAME-KEYED variants incl. NAME x POSITION, ROME-STYLE subject-site edit (a plain weight edit, no oracle positions), information-weighted fits, SOURCE FACTS; each applied alone and removed (readout only)
_inf_eval_trie_inv: known-name decoding over every capitalised word of the stored sentences (local: 5067 names, target always present) instead of the fast store's names
_inf_cf_selfc: self-contrast in the closed-form edit: every answer byte must beat the model's own top non-answer byte (fixed from the unedited model), beside competitor contrast; GPU shadow edits (3 sleeps, 42 conclusions): fitted open 0.17 -> 0.57, held-out MC 0.48 -> 0.65, held-out answer bytes top-1 0.66 -> 0.80, held-out open 0/84 -> 6/84 (shadow without competitor contrast); local: no change (2 seeds)
_inf_latent_judge: LATENT JUDGE readout in sleep: slow-feature cosine on the pairs the byte judge tests (AUC vs controls / random, cost per pair); the byte judge still decides
_sticky_router_eval: STICKY ROUTING readout on mixed held-out streams at pass ends, with the rule cascade signals as reset gates (readout only)
_readouts_9nov: readouts only beyond cg27a_selfc: answer-slot gates (linear / SERAC-style / WISE-style), system-written question forms in the shadow edits, ROME-style fit diagnostic, latent judge hard controls, sleep phases, ceiling tests last
_inf_distill_wake_params: the ONE model change against cg27a_distillw: only the blocks' mlp_out weights take the question gradient (embeddings, shared n-gram tables, heads, mixers get none); local short runs: final BPC +0.010 vs +0.052 with every parameter, Gaussian drift of old domains at the replay-only level
_inf_gauss_drift: readout: per-layer W2 (Bures) drift of the old domains' hidden-state Gaussians on fixed stored sentences, sleep to sleep
_inf_sleep_phase_free: memory: CUDA cache released after each timed sleep phase; the SLEEP PHASES line now gives each phase's own GPU peak
_inf_mem_guard: memory: lean sleeps (latent readouts off, CLS samples halved, caches dropped) once a peak passes 60% of the device (was 70%)
_inf_distill_pool_max: the ONE model change against cg27a_distillm: question pool up to 2000 facts and conclusions from the store, beyond the name memory's cap (GPU cg27a_distillm: the memory reached 381 of 384 entries at visit 4, so the taught set stopped growing at about 300)
_inf_distill_ever: readout: recall over a stable sample of every fact ever taught (and control ever held), by still/left the pool and by age
_inf_eval_chunk: memory: the probe evaluation in chunks of 128 rows (the 70 GB sleep peak); evaluation results unchanged
_inf_jx_rag: ANSWER MODE / READOUT (no model change): each one-hop probe question is answered with one stored sentence in front of it - the sentences naming the subject, ranked by the JEPA key (generic arm G) - and that sentence is CITED. Open-ended and 20-candidate accuracy, weights only vs with the retrieved sentence vs the true sentence, in the written and a held-out wording, and whether the cited source holds the fact. GPU readouts so far: hybrid retrieval 0.92-1.00 written, 0.77-0.85 held-out; 20-candidate one-hop 0.49-0.73 -> 0.64-0.81 with the sentence; open-ended not yet measured
_inf_distill_lchain: readout: LATENT CHAINING - P one-hop applied twice, Q composition learned from the system's concluded chains, on unconcluded chains
_inf_distill_opalg: readout: OPERATOR ALGEBRA on the RULE WORLD (on by default: family and org-chart facts obeying grandchild = child o child, overseen = supervised o supervised, half the composites never planted) - relation operators on the trunk's name codes (closed form) and on a learned projection head: composed operator and learned composite operator on the held-out composites, and RULE DISCOVERY (product nearest which relation) against a shuffled-target null. Toy (tools/toy_jop.py): composed 1.00, rule found
_inf_distill_relmod: 1500 readout (step 3 of the rule test): RELATIONAL MODULE in sleep on the facts the store's reader recorded (every relation, none marked composable): free name codes + relation operators (JEPA-style); rules kept only if they beat 3 shuffled-fact nulls AND the composed operator predicts the recorded composite facts; typed conclusions PROPOSED (not written) and scored against the rule world's held-out composites. Local unit test on clean facts: 2 rules, 0 false, 43 proposals precision 1.00, held-out recall 43/43
_inf_distill_relmod_write: 1 STEP 4 (THE ONE MODEL CHANGE): the relational module's written facts - a rule found against the shuffled null and verified on 0.9+ of its observed composite facts (Wilson bound), applied through STORED premises only - join the distillation question pool as facts (a fifth held back by hash as the control); provenance kept (hops, never evidence). Test: recall from the trunk of composites NEVER PLANTED, taught vs held back. Hard world: 746 + 92 writes, all right; unit check: 43 writes, all right, 31 taught / 12 held back
_inf_reader_chunk: 1 READOUT BUILD (no model change beyond cg27a_relwrite's): the fast sequence channel reads the stored real text into a SEPARATE evidence record (frames = common word sequences, fillers = what varies; counts kept online); [READER vs GOLD] scores the old and new records against the Re-DocRED gold relations each sleep; [RELATIONAL MODULE, REAL TEXT] mines rules among real frames, proposals scored against gold, nothing written. Offline: 325 / in-model unit check 338 gold relations vs 36 for the current reader; local run: identical training, readouts at sleep 2: 35 vs 4
_inf_rw_nosleep: 1 THE CLEAN STEP-4 CONTROL (T7): the sleep layer never concludes the rule world's two-hop pairs (held out like inf_kgx_hold), so a grandchild / overseen fact reaches the trunk only through the relational module's write; taught vs held back is then clean. GPU cg27a_chunk sleep 4: 3 of the 4 taught and all held-back written facts were also sleep-layer conclusions
_inf_distill_align: + 0.5 x (1 - cosine) between the question row's state at the answer and the declaration's; readout [DISTILLATION, VIEW ALIGNMENT]
_inf_distill_replay: 4 stored source sentences per question-row step (pool and control facts); readout [DISTILLATION, SOURCE REPLAY]
_inf_distill_rtx_title: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: pronoun-led replayed sentences replayed with the document's title for the pronoun
_inf_distill_rtx_slot: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: benchmark sentences replayed and asked through domain 1's slot (Wikipedia)
_inf_preq: readout: PREQUENTIAL BITS after every visit (held-out text of the domains read and the next domain, weights only)
_inf_extract_gain: readout: EXTRACTION GAIN inside the compression-gain readout (every 2 visits)
_inf_sstore: off: cg27a_prem's model change is not part of this build
_inf_premises: readout: PREMISES AT SCALE every 2 visits (a separate record store; nothing reaches training)
_inf_rti_write: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: gated real-text inferences written into the question pool
_inf_rti_policy: premises sampled at random (10%), the bridges and the check do the selecting: GPU cg27a_prem, A-C right with 2+ bridges from premises kept at random 0.178 / 0.188 (visits 2 / 4) vs trunk surprise 0.132 / 0.120 vs block association 0.061 / 0.081
_inf_rti_code: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: choose the inferences to write by the compressed fact table (name codes) on held-out pairs
_inf_rti_ctl: control: a third of written inferences held back by their own hash
_inf_rcode_k: 512 dims: offline the code needs room once noisy distant records are added (code-512 AUC 0.618 -> 0.698 with 30k distant documents; 128 dims was diluted)
_inf_rti_rows: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: 8 rows of taught real-text inferences added to every question-row step
_inf_rti_rank_recall: readout: rank recall among 10 written answers, taught vs held back, right vs wrong
_inf_rcode_sel: THE ONE MODEL CHANGE (with inf_rti_max 100): write the pairs the code and Adamic-Adar agree on most
_inf_rti_max: 100 a readout (part of the change: fewer, better)
_inf_rcode_selreport: readout: labelled share of the top 100 / 200 under code, Adamic-Adar and the rank sum
